Parque de diversões. O dia de diversão dos garotos no parque aquático está prestes a acabar mal... muito mal.

CSI.us: Let The Seller Beware. Grissom and Catherine investigate the murder of a wealthy couple who are found outside their home, which was up for sale.
A Little Murder. Grissom suspects murder when the body of a dwarf is found hanging from a rope high above a stage in a casino hotel where a convention of little people is being held.
Abra Cadaver. Grissom, Warrick, and Sara investigate when a woman vanishes while taking part in a magician's act.

Harvest. A young girl is abducted from outside a convenience store, triggering an Amber alert.
Crow's Feet. A woman is found dead in a hotel suite with symptoms of the ebola virus.
Swap Meet. Grissom and Sara investigate the murder of a woman after a swap party where the married couples in the neighborhood meet and switch partners.
Formalities. Grissom is called to a murder of a 17-year-old in a casino penthouse. The entire team gets involved when its discovered that a kidnapping took place along with the murder.
What's Eating Gilbert Grissom?. The killer from The Execution of Catherine Willows returns with deadly results.

Mea Culpa. Grissom is confronted with new evidence while on the stand of a murder trial of a restaurant owner.
CSIenespanol.us: Adiós y buena suerte. Un sospechoso del pasado de Sara regresa, haciendo que se cuestione su futuro como CSI.

Me matas. Hodges tiene segundas intenciones cuando escenifica hipotéticos asesinatos en el laboratorio para dar a sus colegas la oportunidad de jugar a ser CSI.
Yaciendo con perros. Grissom y su equipo se adentran en el mundo de las peleas ilegales de perros para averiguar quién es el responsable de la muerte de una acaudalada dama de la alta sociedad.
Toro. Grissom y su equipo investigan dos asesinatos que tienen lugar en el rodeo anual de monta de toros de Las Vegas.

La divina comedia de Grissom. Grissom y su equipo luchan contra la gripe cuando el fiscal Klein les pide que investiguen la muerte de varios testigos clave para un caso del gran jurado contra una peli
Mil días sobre la tierra. La inquietante muerte de una niña de 3 años tiene un gran impacto en Catherine mientras busca pistas sobre su asesinato.
Venta de gotas. Brass y Nick reciben ayuda de una fuente poco probable, un criminal encarcelado (Method Man), cuando investigan dos asesinatos que tienen lugar en el mismo edificio de apartamentos.
La teoría de todo. Grissom y su equipo descubren varias víctimas que tienen sangre verde, lo que les lleva a la conclusión de que sus muertes están conectadas de algún modo.

Dos muertes y media. Grissom y el equipo de CSI se ven envueltos en el mundo de la comedia de Hollywood cuando una diva de las comedias de situación (Sagal) muere prematuramente durante el rodaje de s

Piloto. Gil Grissom es el supervisor del turno de noche de los investigadores de élite de la escena del crimen de Las Vegas. Holly Gribbs, recién salida de la academia, se une al equipo.
Buen cambio. Un hombre es asesinado después de haber ganado una fortuna y haber dejado a su novia. Entonces, Grissom, Nick y la recién llegada al equipo de CSI, Sara Sidle, investigan este caso.
Cajón y entierro. Grissom, Nick y Sara buscan a una mujer secuestrada y encuentran más de lo que esperaban. Catherine y Warrick investigan la muerte por atropello con fuga de una niña.
DeadlyWomen.us: Dark Secrets. Judi Buenoano secretly murdered lovers to claim on insurance policies whilst nurse Genene Jones secretly killed at least 46 infants left in her care between 1980 and 1982.
Till Death Do Us Part. While marriage is meant to be for life, it often ends in divorce. These wives took their marriages vow seriously: "till death do us part."
Fortune Hunters. Greed is one of the oldest motives for murder, and these deadly women are no exception: they’ll do anything to satisfy their need for cash. This is the dangerous world of the fortune
Lethal Lovers. Psychopathic killers lurk in society, mostly acting alone. Sometimes fate brings them into contact with another person who shares their cold power to kill.

Mothers Who Kill. We want to believe that all women would give their lives to protect their children. But there are horrifying cases when a mother will turn against her natural instinct and kill her o
Fatal Attraction. No one doubts a woman’s capacity to love, but sometimes lust can turn lethal. In the ultimate fatal attraction, "Deadly Women" looks at cases of murder driven by obsessive love.

In Cold Blood. The heaviest judgments of convicted killers are reserved for those who committed premeditated murder. These women plot and plan. They know the consequences of their actions, but still t
Blood Lines. Blood ties are strong ties, sometimes strong enough to pull a person into a murderous conspiracy. When a family member wields his or her power, the result can be death.
Greed. Known as “black widows,” these women kill their spouses, lovers and children for profit. Murder for them becomes a business. Their trade is murder. Their profit? Blood money.

Behind the Mask. Behind lace-curtained windows and beneath sensible haircuts lurked evil. Appearances were deceptive. We did not notice these female killers walking by. These women wore a mask of sani
Bad Medicine. Nurse Beverley Allitt overdosed multiple infants, Stella Nickell poisoned medicine capsules in stores and Kathleen Follbigg killed four of her own children.
Dangerous Liaisons. Sometimes, when a man and a woman unite, a terrible urge for destruction can awaken in them both. Happy couples become deadly teams, intent on one goal: murder.
Born Bad. The mind of a female killer is shaped by a complex cocktail of influences. Do people become that way, driven by horrendous events in their lives? Or are some killers born bad?
An Eye for an Eye. The path towards revenge can sometimes lead to murder. It can be quick, fiery and violent. It can also be a dish served cold, the product of a calm, calculated plot.
